text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's finally time for the autumn Tenno Sho, where the showdown of the "top three" will take place.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: In the lead-up to the race, the members of BNW spend their time together like always.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But the racecourse is where they'll share their thoughts and feelings.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Narita Taishin heads to the track with a fire burning quietly within her.
